paragraphs: Rav Menashya, his son, [Eruvin 64a](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.64a.10); Hyman says the correct reading is “of Difta,” as in Eruvin 43b according to Ein Yaakov.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Eruvin 64a reads Gifti in the name of Menashya’s father. Hyman’s Difti is his proposed correction based on the Ein Yaakov reading he cites for 43b.
